drums.tags: Hard rock drum stem. The performance features a standard four-piece kit with a crisp, dry snare and a punchy kick drum. The hi-hats are played slightly open for a washier texture during more intense sections. The drummer utilizes frequent crash cymbal accents and occasional ride cymbal bell hits. The pattern is characterized by a steady backbeat with syncopated kick drum variations and rapid sixteenth-note snare fills. The recording has a natural room resonance with minimal artificial reverb. 120 BPM. 4/4 time signature.

bass.tags: Hard rock instrumental featuring a prominent, overdriven electric bass guitar playing a repetitive, syncopated riff. The track is built around a heavy, mid-tempo groove at 105 BPM in the key of E minor. A distorted electric guitar enters with sustained power chords and feedback swells. The drum kit maintains a steady backbeat with a dry snare and a punchy kick drum that emphasizes the bass rhythm. The production is raw and aggressive, with the bass guitar occupying the center of the mix and utilizing a high-gain fuzz or overdrive pedal to create a thick, harmonically rich texture. The arrangement is minimalist, focusing on the interplay between the driving bass line and the atmospheric guitar layers.
